description: This file defines the EntityTag class which models HTTP entity tags as specified by RFC 7232. It includes validation, comparison methods (strong and weak), and parsing from string representations.

classes.name: EntityTag
classes.description: Immutable class representing an HTTP entity tag with support for weak and strong validation and comparison.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates if the given CharSequence is a properly formatted entity tag, optionally weak, matching the regex pattern.

methods.name: getOpaqueTag
methods.description: Returns the opaque tag string part of the EntityTag.

methods.name: isWeak
methods.description: Indicates whether this entity tag is weak.

methods.name: strongCompareTo
methods.description: Performs a strong comparison with another EntityTag, requiring both to be strong and have matching opaque tags.

methods.name: weakCompareTo
methods.description: Performs a weak comparison with another EntityTag based solely on opaque tags.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates an EntityTag instance from its string representation, parsing weak/strong prefix.

methods.name: fromEntity
methods.description: Builds an EntityTag from an arbitrary entity object, if possible.

methods.name: strong
methods.description: Creates a strong entity tag with a specified opaque value.

methods.name: weak
methods.description: Creates a weak entity tag with a specified opaque value.
